subject: DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD function
notes: r5 states an evaluation equivalence over a clock reading, so the golden asserts the equivalence rather than a value. r5's expression may not be WRITTEN in argument-3 (§8.4.3.2.3 SR11 over §15.67.1 and §15.23.3 r4), so it is staged through an integer item by a COMPUTE and the omitted form is compared against the explicit one. The window boundary is put ON the execution year (YY = MOD(CY,100), argument-1 = YY*10000+1003) and the identity asserted at argument-2 = 0 AND argument-2 = -1, so by §15.100.4 a one-year skew low breaks the first probe and one-year skew high the second — the fixed 851003/10 shape it replaced was constant across a ~100-year band. Clock-free witnesses beside it: mmdd = 1003 by §15.23.4 r1, and two explicit argument-3 values that must differ (18851003 / 19851003).
